mapper.sql: pk_id, id, tenant_id, people_id, kind, engine_code, disease_code, rule_pack_version, status, level, score, probability, result_json, input_snapshot_json, trigger_source, assessed_at, assessed_by_staff_id, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO people_assessment_snapshot( id, tenant_id, people_id, kind, engine_code, disease_code, rule_pack_version, status, level, score, probability, result_json, input_snapshot_json, trigger_source, assessed_at, assessed_by_staff_id, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{peopleId}, #{kind}, #{engineCode}, #{diseaseCode}, #{rulePackVersion}, #{status}, #{level}, #{score}, #{probability}, #{resultJson}, #{inputSnapshotJson}, #{triggerSource}, #{assessedAt}, #{assessedByStaffId}, #{isDeleted}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified}, #{gmtDeleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM people_assessment_snapshot WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY engine_code ORDER BY assessed_at DESC, pk_id DESC) AS rn FROM people_assessment_snapshot t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.people_id = #{peopleId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.engine_code
